items.title: What Could Walt Disney (DIS) AI Push Mean For Its Creative Future?
items.summary: Adobe and Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) announced a new multi-year alliance to deploy AI tools for Disney creatives on 9 November 2026. The partnership will bring Adobe AI software into Disney film, TV, parks, cruise development and marketing workflows. Disney creative teams are expected to use Adobe tools for script development support, visual effects workflows and content localization. items.title: What Does CoreWeave (CRWV) Winning A New AI Training Deal Mean?
items.summary: CoreWeave (NasdaqGS:CRWV) has agreed a multi year AI cloud infrastructure deal with autonomous driving company Wayve. The agreement will supply NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs that Wayve plans to use for training its autonomous vehicle AI models. CoreWeave is providing dedicated AI cloud capacity tailored to large scale physical AI workloads for autonomous driving development.
